editorial:
Imagine trying to get your life back together after a scary attack, only to take on a patient who is even more broken than you are. That is exactly what happens here. You follow a psychiatrist who is struggling with her own trauma while trying to help a mysterious man who has a very dark past. The vibe is heavy and tense, making you feel like something is always about to go wrong. It is a slow burn that builds up a lot of stress, leaving you wondering who is actually in control of the situation and who is lying.

The acting is top-notch and really sells the tension between the two leads. You will love the twists, although some parts move a bit slowly for my taste. If you like movies that play with your mind and keep you guessing, you should definitely give this a shot. endingExplained: You find out that the doctor and her patient are actually the same person or linked in a strange way. The twist reveals that the psychiatrist was imagining the sessions to deal with her own guilt and trauma. The movie ends by showing that she cannot escape her past. It turns out the patient was a projection of her own broken mind, and the cycle of pain just keeps repeating itself in her head.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and dark twists.
